switcher.heading: Switch workspace
createModal.title: Create a workspace
createModal.name.label: Name
createModal.slug.label: Slug
createModal.slug.hint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes — used in the X-Strapi-Space-Id header and API calls.
createModal.color.label: Color
settings.title: Workspaces
settings.subtitle: Create, rename and archive the workspaces of this deployment.
settings.edit.title: Edit {name}
settings.edit.slug.hint: Changing the slug updates the X-Strapi-Space-Id identifier — external API consumers must follow.
settings.edit.slug.locked: The default workspace slug is locked — it is the system fallback.
settings.delete.label: Delete {name}
settings.delete.confirm: Are you sure you want to delete {name}? Its entries must have been moved or deleted first.
settings.capabilities.title: Capabilities
settings.capabilities.hint: What this workspace can see and do. Disabled Settings sections disappear there; content behaviors are enforced server-side. The Default workspace always sees everything.
roles.workspaces.hint: Users holding this role belong to these workspaces. With every workspace checked the role is available everywhere.
tokens.workspaces.hint: The token can only read and write inside these workspaces — sending another workspace in the X-Strapi-Space-Id header is refused. With every workspace checked the token is platform-wide.
plugin.name: Workspaces
ctb.workspaces.label: Workspaces
ctb.workspaces.description: One checked = exclusive to that workspace. Several = shared between them.
move.action.label: Move to workspace…
move.dialog.title: Move to another workspace
move.dialog.body: Move {count, plural, one {this entry} other {these # entries}} to:
move.dialog.empty.title: This entry cannot be moved to another workspace.
move.dialog.empty.hint: This content type only exists in the current workspace — add another workspace to its "Workspaces" selection in the Content-Type Builder first.
move.success: {count, plural, one {Entry moved} other {# entries moved}} to {space}.
visibilityField.label: Available in workspaces
visibilityField.hint: Uncheck workspaces to limit visibility. With every workspace checked the row is shared everywhere.
defaultPicker.label: Default in workspaces
defaultPicker.hint: Pick one or more workspaces this locale should be the default in. Picking a workspace here also adds it to "Available in workspaces" automatically.
defaultPicker.placeholder: Not the default in any workspace
